methodology.eventSplit: 25% deterministic event-disjoint holdout reserved before search
methodology.split: Remaining events use 60% train / 20% validation / 20% untouched chronological holdout with future-mark purge
methodology.refinementSource: Only base rules with a positive train lower bound are refined by category and entry band
methodology.strategy4ContractGate: Reject path barriers and exact numeric ranges; require 14 hours to market end at entry
methodology.limitation: Current active-market selection is survivorship biased; any holdout winner still requires resolved-market external validation
